title: General areas for improvement and operation
summary: Feedback in this topic is loosely grouped around broad judgments of the car, with some praise, one clear complaint about usability trade-offs, and several vague mentions of areas needing improvement without enough detail.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the car favorably in broad terms, although some example assignments appear to conflict with the wording and provide limited concrete detail.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says some controls or functions became easier to operate while others became more awkward, indicating a usability trade-off.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention that some areas could be improved or are incomplete, but they do not specify the exact issue clearly enough to summarize further.

limitations: This cluster is weakly defined and consists mostly of broad statements rather than a single clear product aspect.
Several example sentiment assignments appear inconsistent with the fragment wording, so the positive examples should be interpreted cautiously.
Some fragments are incomplete or too vague to identify the exact feature or issue being discussed.
